blocks.meaning: A blob leaf: a positioned pointer at one chunk.
blocks.name: tree.leaf

blocks.meaning: A blob interior node: two ordered subtrees, no payload.
blocks.name: tree.parent

blocks.meaning: A named file over a blob manifest.
blocks.name: file.file

blocks.meaning: The journal's first entry: no note, no edges.
blocks.name: entry.genesis

blocks.meaning: One journal entry over a file, linked to its predecessor.
blocks.name: entry.entry

blocks.meaning: A folded context: no payload, one typed edge per folded item.
blocks.name: context.context

blocks.meaning: A code point that admits a node whose references name operands.
blocks.name: step.put

blocks.meaning: A code point that loads an operand.
blocks.name: step.load

blocks.meaning: A defunctionalized program: the line count, and one edge per code point in order.
blocks.name: cont.cont

edges.meaning: the blob tree this manifest heads
edges.name: manifest.manifest.root

edges.meaning: the blob manifest holding the file's bytes
edges.name: file.file.content

edges.meaning: One edge per folded item, in fold order, any number of them. The sort fixes no slot list — a context is whatever was folded — so what holds instead is a law: every edge's expected tag must resolve through Ty.ofTag, a context edge may not carry an unratified tag. CasExamples.AgentStep.agentStep is the consumer that satisfies it, reading each edge tag off the node it loaded.
edges.name: context.context.item.<index>

edges.meaning: One edge per code point, in program order, any number of them — a program's length is not a slot list. Every edge expects the step tag, which is stronger than the free law this discipline states; what the law itself forbids is a table edge at an unratified tag.
edges.name: cont.cont.line.<index>

fields.meaning: the value's bytes; nothing in the grammar reads them
fields.name: value.value.payload

fields.meaning: the chunk's bytes
fields.name: chunk.chunk.bytes

fields.meaning: the leaf's absolute chunk index within the blob
fields.name: tree.leaf.index

fields.meaning: the declared byte length of the chunk
fields.name: tree.leaf.length

fields.meaning: the chunking recipe id (1 = fixed-size chunks)
fields.name: manifest.manifest.recipe

fields.meaning: the blob's total byte length
fields.name: manifest.manifest.totalBytes

fields.meaning: how many leaves the tree carries
fields.name: manifest.manifest.leafCount

fields.meaning: the file name, UTF-8, under 2^16 bytes
fields.name: file.file.name

fields.meaning: the media type, UTF-8, under 2^16 bytes
fields.name: file.file.mediaType

fields.meaning: the entry's note bytes, uninterpreted
fields.name: entry.entry.note

fields.meaning: 0x00 — this code point admits a node
fields.name: step.put.form

fields.meaning: the scheme version of the node the line admits
fields.name: step.put.version

fields.meaning: the wire kind tag of the node the line admits
fields.name: step.put.tag

fields.meaning: the admitted node's payload bytes, self-delimiting
fields.name: step.put.payload

fields.meaning: how many typed operand records follow
fields.name: step.put.operandCount

fields.meaning: operandCount records, each an expected-tag byte then an operand (0x00 and a 32-byte address, or 0x01 and a 32-bit answer index)
fields.name: step.put.operands

fields.meaning: 0x01 — this code point loads an operand
fields.name: step.load.form

fields.meaning: 0x00 a literal address, 0x01 an earlier answer
fields.name: step.load.operandKind

fields.meaning: the operand's bytes: 32 address bytes under 0x00, a 32-bit big-endian index under 0x01
fields.name: step.load.operand

fields.meaning: how many code points the table holds
fields.name: cont.cont.lineCount

fields.meaning: the git loose-object preimage: the type word, a space, the decimal byte length, a NUL, then the object's content
fields.name: git.git.object

fields.meaning: the schema's canonical bytes, opaque at this layer
fields.name: schema.schema.bytes
